title: Robert Saleh: We've put more on Cam Ward's plate and he's proving he can handle it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: We've put more on Cam Ward's plate and he's proving he can handle it
sources.description: The Titans lost their third straight game on Sunday, but head coach Robert Saleh continued to like what he saw from quarterback Cam Ward during Jacksonville's 40-23 win.
